name: Adventure in My Head
source:
One guy really liked to fantasize and come up with different unusual adventures in his head. His girlfriend Masha noticed this and suggested taking a walk, since the main character only did what he sat at home and dreamed of different worlds. After all, bright colors, shimmering in the real world, should inspire a guy to live for today.

You play as a guy and read a story about him, about his thoughts and fate. He lives at home all the time and has never even seen the street! After all, he must understand that it is necessary to live here and now, and not sit at home and be constantly alone. Masha will just give him this idea...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1907170/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个男孩特别喜欢幻想，总在脑海里编织各种奇妙的冒险。他的女友玛莎注意到了这一点，便提议出去散步——毕竟，主人公整天只知道待在家里，幻想着不同的世界。现实世界中闪耀的鲜活色彩，或许能鼓励他活在当下。

你将扮演这个男孩，阅读关于他、他的思绪与命运的故事。他始终待在家里，甚至从未见过外面的街道！他必须明白，人应该活在此时此刻，而不是总把自己关在家里，独自一人。玛莎将把这个想法带给他……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1907170/]Steam[/url]]
